messages:
Mira Patel: Heads-up: need coordinated marketplace + press timing for H100/H200/B200, MI300, Gaudi. Any absolute blackout dates in Apr-May?

Vendor PM - Nvidia: Tentative firmware freeze for H100/H200 on 2026-04-21 (+/-5d). Press week may be late April, confirming.

Vendor PM - Habana: Gaudi team requests extra perf validation 2026-04-13 to 04-19. No strict embargo, just runway.

Kelvin Cho: Ops note: freeze blocks driver/image rebuilds. MI300 driver parity fix aimed 2026-05-02 (could shift). B200 inventory ok for June.

Alex Kim: Marketplace needs final image + EULA + matrix 10 business days before publish. If freeze 4/21, need artifacts by ~4/07. For mid-May announce need final by 5/01.

Sofia Alvarez: SI dry-run proposed: Gaudi/H100 on 2026-04-12, MI300 on 2026-05-05. Checklist: image pull, driver-kernel check, KV-cache smoke, sample inference run, tracing hooks.

Kelvin Cho: We can carve 6-node lab pools for 4/12 and 5/05. Please file provisioning tickets by EOD Fri.

Ryan O'Neal: Legal: EULA and OEM attribution lines required by 2026-04-09 for primary; fallback compressed by 4/22. Attribution example: "Hardware vendor names and trademarks used with permission."

Mira Patel: Proposed plan: primary consolidated announce 2026-05-10 to 05-17 (wait for MI300); fallback smallwave late-April if vendors confirm earlier.

Alex Kim: I'll start SKU templates and block marketplace QA. Marketing: avoid overlapping vendor press.

Mira Patel: Actions: Mira confirm freezes & press windows by 2026-04-02; Kelvin provisioning tickets by 2026-03-28; Alex SKU + marketing hold by 2026-03-30; Sofia dry-run invites by 2026-03-29; Ryan collect vendor legal contacts by 2026-03-29.

Vendor PM - Nvidia: Will confirm press window and freeze certainty by 2026-03-31.

Sofia Alvarez: :thumbsup: will coordinate integrators after confirmations.

Mira Patel: Thanks — ping here for any changes.
